briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as job gains keep pace with moderate inflation pressures.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 runs above the Fed's target, holding rates elevated.
Unemployment at 4.1 percent for Oct 2026 tightened, sustaining household income and spending.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 4.92 percent to 4.91 percent.
